info.title: AlterCPA Lite — Flows & Ways API
info.description: Manage flows (traffic channels) and ways (destination paths within flows). All endpoints support scope parameter (must be in GET query string even when POSTing JSON). Success is HTTP 200; an error is answered with the HTTP status of its error code (400 generic, 401 key/auth, 402 unpaid, 403 access/ban, 404 no-id/bad-id/not-found, 500 app/func/db; bot answers 418) and repeated in the X-API-Status and X-API-Error headers.

Scope.name: scope
Scope.description: Access scope. Must be in GET query string even when body is JSON. Default: user.

FlowId.name: fid
FlowId.description: Numeric flow ID. Alternative: flow= (symbolic code like ef1c).

FlowCode.name: flow
FlowCode.description: Symbolic flow code (e.g. ef1c). Alternative: fid= (numeric).

XApiStatus.description: Result status repeated from the body

XApiError.description: Error code repeated from the body

BadRequest.description: Function-level error (HTTP 400): scope, user-required, limit-reached, no-name, no-way, create, add, access-denied, wrong-user, wrong-way; any error code not listed for another status.

Unauthorized.description: Error key (API key missing or wrong) or auth.

Forbidden.description: Error ban (user banned or inactive) or access.

NotFound.description: no-id (flow or way id missing), bad-id (flow not found).

ServerError.description: Error db (database failure); framework errors func/app.

error.description: scope, unpaid, no-id, bad-id, wrong-way, access-denied, wrong-user, no-name, no-way, limit-reached, user-required, create, add

spath.description: Path to white site on storage

goal.description: Cap goal encoding: 0 = any lead (no goal condition), 1 = leads with no goal, n+1 = leads tagged with goal slot n. The cap counts the leads whose own goal equals max(0, goal - 1).

get.description: Error codes by HTTP status: 400 scope; 402 unpaid.
